scripts.text: - You are carrying too many items! -
scripts.translation: - 您携带的物品太多了！ -

scripts.text:
[Tialfi]
Hmmm...
I can feel a strange force growing stronger and stronger, somewhere in Midgard.
scripts.translation:
[提亚尔菲]
嗯...
我感觉到米德加尔特某处有一股奇怪的力量正在不断增强。

scripts.text:
[Tialfi]
Can you feel it?
Something must be
going on!
scripts.translation:
[提亚尔菲]
你能感觉到吗？
一定有什么事要发生了！

scripts.text:
[Tialfi]
I'm waiting for the day when I'll finally get to see Thor's thunder for myself. I believe that one of these days, my dream will become reality.
scripts.translation:
[提亚尔菲]
我一直在等着亲眼见识托尔的雷霆。 / 我相信，总有一天梦想会成真。

scripts.text:
[Tialfi]
You came back!
In exchange for the ores that you have brought me, I will give you one of my family treasures.
scripts.translation:
[提亚尔菲]
你回来了！
作为对你带来矿石的回报，我会送你一件家传宝物。

scripts.text:
[Tialfi]
You have two options in choosing a treasure. You can have a treasure that will be useful to yourself, or something that may suit one of your friends.
scripts.translation:
[提亚尔菲]
宝物有两种选法：挑一件自己用得上的，或是挑一件适合朋友的。

scripts.text:
[Tialfi]
So which treasure
would you like to have?
scripts.translation:
[提亚尔菲]
那么，你想选择哪件宝物呢？

scripts.text: An item that I can use.
scripts.translation: 我自己能用的

scripts.text: An item that my friend can use.
scripts.translation: 朋友能用的

scripts.text:
[Tialfi]
I see...
Give me a moment
to find a suitable
item for you.
scripts.translation:
[提亚尔菲]
明白了...
请稍等，我去找一件适合你的物品。

scripts.text:
[Tialfi]
I see...
Give me a moment
to find a suitable
item for your friend.
scripts.translation:
[提亚尔菲]
明白了...
请稍等，我去找一件适合你朋友的物品。

scripts.text:
[Tialfi]
Okay, let's see...
I seem to recall that I put it somewhere around... Hmm.
It must be around--Ah!
Here we are~
scripts.translation:
[提亚尔菲]
让我找找...记得是放在这附近...嗯。
应该就在...啊，找到了~

scripts.text: Unknown error occurred.
scripts.translation: 发生未知错误。

scripts.text:
[Tialfi]
Once again, I thank you for the trouble you've gone through on my behalf. I'm unsure of how this works, but I hope it will be useful to you. From what I know, I believe this is a rare item.
scripts.translation:
[提亚尔菲]
再次感谢你替我奔波。
这东西怎么用，我也不清楚，不过希望能帮到你。
据我所知，它应该很稀有。

scripts.text:
[Tialfi]
I'll be waiting for the day when I'll see Thor's thunder for myself. I believe that the dream I've had will come true, one of these days.
scripts.translation:
[提亚尔菲]
我会一直等到亲眼见识托尔的雷霆。 / 我相信，我的梦想总有一天会实现。

scripts.text:
[Tialfi]
I need
50 Rough Oridecon
and 50 Rough Elunium.
scripts.translation:
[提亚尔菲]
我需要：
50个神之金属原石，
还有50个铝原石。

scripts.text:
[Tialfi]
I don't have much time, so go ahead and continue on your journeys if you can't bring those to me.
scripts.translation:
[提亚尔菲]
我时间不多，如果你无法把这些带给我，就请继续你的旅程吧。

scripts.text:
[Tialfi]
I sense a strange energy growing more powerful somewhere on this continent...
scripts.translation:
[提亚尔菲]
我感觉到这片大陆的某处有一股奇怪的能量正在变得更强...

scripts.text:
[Tialfi]
Can you feel it?
Something must be going on!
scripts.translation:
[提亚尔菲]
你能感觉到吗？
一定有什么事要发生了！

scripts.text:
[Tialfi]
I think we'd better wait and see what's happening. Someone will deliver the news to us. Though, I am unsure of whether or not it will be good news or bad...
scripts.translation:
[提亚尔菲]
我想，还是先等等，看发生了什么。
总会有人带来消息，只是不知道会是喜讯，还是噩耗...

scripts.text:
[Tialfi]
You've met the four Dwarven Blacksmiths. I've heard that they rarely speak to humans. So you must be special if you were able to talk to them.
scripts.translation:
[提亚尔菲]
你见到了四位矮人铁匠？
听说他们很少跟人类说话。
能让他们开口，你一定很特别。

scripts.text:
[Tialfi]
Do you think that my dream will come true? Do you believe Thor's Mjolnir will appear before the eyes of humans? I'm afraid great change will come to this world.
scripts.translation:
[提亚尔菲]
你说，我的梦想会实现吗？
托尔的雷神之锤，真的会出现在人类面前吗？
恐怕这个世界要发生巨变了。

scripts.text:
[Tialfi]
Thank you for going through such trouble on my behalf. I wish to give you one of my family treasures as a token of my gratitude.
scripts.translation:
[提亚尔菲]
谢谢你为我费心。我想送你一件家传宝物，以表谢意。

scripts.text:
[Tialfi]
However, I hope you understand that my family would grow suspicious if one of the treasures were to just go missing.
scripts.translation:
[提亚尔菲]
不过，希望你能理解，如果一件宝物突然失踪，我的家人肯定会起疑心。

scripts.text:
[Tialfi]
Hmm, however, I don't think they'll complain if I exchanged one of the treasures for something else. Let me think...
scripts.translation:
[提亚尔菲]
嗯，不过如果他们知道我是用一件宝物换了别的东西，应该就不会抱怨了。让我想想...

scripts.text:
[Tialfi]
I should be able to give you
one of our family heirlooms if you can bring be 50 Rough Oridecons and 50 Rough Eluniums.
scripts.translation:
[提亚尔菲]
如果你能给我50个神之金属原石和50个铝原石，我就可以送你一件家传宝物。

scripts.text:
[Tialfi]
You don't have to do that if you don't want to. But it seems our family heirlooms would be more useful to an adventurer such as yourself...
scripts.translation:
[提亚尔菲]
如果你不愿意，也可以不做。但看来这些家传宝物对你这样的冒险者更有用...

scripts.text:
[Tialfi]
Hmm...
The Dwarven Blacksmiths
must be upset at you for
some reason.
scripts.translation:
[提亚尔菲]
嗯...
矮人铁匠们一定因为某件事对你很不满。

scripts.text:
[Tialfi]
Remember my sister's
suggestion and speak to
them with great courtesy.
Carefully choose words
of respect lest they
be insulted.
scripts.translation:
[提亚尔菲]
记住我姐姐的叮嘱，对他们一定要毕恭毕敬。
说话时仔细斟酌，别失了礼数。

scripts.text:
[Tialfi]
You should be okay now.
By this time, they've probably forgotten the insult. But make sure you speak to my sister for advice first.
scripts.translation:
[提亚尔菲]
现在应该没问题了。
到这个时候，他们大概已经忘了那件事。但记得先去找我姐姐问问建议。

scripts.text:
[Tialfi]
Sorry for the trouble.
I wish you good luck
in finding the Dwarves!
Just... Don't insult them!
scripts.translation:
[提亚尔菲]
抱歉给你添麻烦了。
祝你在寻找矮人时好运！
只是...千万别冒犯他们！

scripts.text:
[Tialfi]
I sense a strange energy growing more powerful somewhere on this continent...
scripts.translation:
[提亚尔菲]
我感觉到这片大陆的某处有一股奇怪的能量正在变得更强...

scripts.text:
[Tialfi]
Can you feel it?
Something must be going on!
scripts.translation:
[提亚尔菲]
你能感觉到吗？
一定有什么事要发生了！

scripts.text:
[Tialfi]
I think we'd better wait and see what's happening. Someone will deliver the news to us. Though, I am unsure of whether or not it will be good news or bad...
scripts.translation:
[提亚尔菲]
我想，还是先等等，看发生了什么。
总会有人带来消息，只是不知道会是喜讯，还是噩耗...

scripts.text:
[Tialfi]
One of my ancestors supposedly was a servant of Thor. Still, I find it difficult to believe.
scripts.translation:
[提亚尔菲]
据说，我有位祖先曾经是托尔的仆人。
不过，这实在很难相信。

scripts.text:
[Tialfi]
If the gods have all these powers, how could a mere human be of any real assistance?
scripts.translation:
[提亚尔菲]
如果众神拥有如此强大的力量，区区人类又能帮上什么忙呢？

scripts.text:
[Tialfi]
Last night, I had the most amazing dream where I was the servant of Thor, god of thunder.
scripts.translation:
[提亚尔菲]
昨晚，我做了一个不可思议的梦，梦里我是雷神托尔的仆人。

scripts.text:
[Tialfi]
In this dream, I traveled
with Thor to Jotunnheim, land of giants. During our journey, he told me many interesting stories about gods and heroes.
scripts.translation:
[提亚尔菲]
在梦中，我跟随托尔前往巨人国度约顿海姆。旅途中，他给我讲了许多关于众神和英雄的有趣故事。

scripts.text:
[Tialfi]
Of course, I can't remember everything clearly, but it was truly fantastic.
scripts.translation:
[提亚尔菲]
当然，我记不清所有细节，但那真的非常精彩。

scripts.text:
[Tialfi]
For some reason, I can vividly recall what Thor told me about his weapon, Mjolnir. Mjolnir is a Dwarven masterpiece.
scripts.translation:
[提亚尔菲]
不知为什么，托尔谈起武器雷神之锤时说的话，我却记得清清楚楚。
那可是矮人的杰作。

scripts.text:
[Tialfi]
Thor told me that Dwarves are extremely talented artisans, and their works are supreme. So as
I was thinking about my dream,
I remembered...
scripts.translation:
[提亚尔菲]
托尔说，矮人是天赋非凡的工匠，作品举世无双。
回想起这段梦境，我忽然想到...

scripts.text:
[Tialfi]
There is a mountain that
has the same name as Thor's
weapon. Surely, the two have
some relation to each other.
scripts.translation:
[提亚尔菲]
有一座山与托尔的武器同名。这两者之间肯定有某种联系。

scripts.text:
[Tialfi]
I've also recently heard a rumor that Dwarven Blacksmiths also reside on Mount Mjolnir.
I understand the mountain is dangerous, and that I'm in no position to ask such a thing...
scripts.translation:
[提亚尔菲]
最近我还听到一个传闻，说矮人铁匠也住在妙勒尼山脉上。
我知道那座山很危险，我也知道我不该提出这样的要求...

scripts.text:
[Tialfi]
I can't help wanting to know for myself whether or not there is truth to my dream. Is it possible for Mjolnir to resurface?
scripts.translation:
[提亚尔菲]
我实在想知道，这个梦到底有没有依据。
雷神之锤真的有可能重现于世吗？

scripts.text:
[Tialfi]
If you don't mind, I'd like to ask you to explore this mountain and search for these Dwarven Blacksmiths.
scripts.translation:
[提亚尔菲]
如果不介意的话，我想请你探索这座山，寻找这些矮人铁匠。

scripts.text: No.
scripts.translation: 不

scripts.text: Okay.
scripts.translation: 好的

scripts.text:
[Tialfi]
I see. But I still appreciate that you took the time to listen to me.
Hopefully someday I'll learn the truth about my dreams and about Mjolnir itself.
scripts.translation:
[提亚尔菲]
我明白了。但我还是很感激你愿意花时间听我倾诉。
希望有一天我能弄清我梦境的真相，以及雷神之锤本身的秘密。

scripts.text:
[Tialfi]
Thank you,
thank you so much!
Even though it won't be easy, I have faith that if the Dwarven Blacksmiths do exist, you'll be able to find them.
scripts.translation:
[提亚尔菲]
谢谢，真是太感谢你了！
虽然不容易，但我相信，只要那些矮人铁匠确实存在，你就一定能找到他们。

scripts.text:
[Tialfi]
Oh, and please speak to my sister Roskva first. She is outside the North Entrance of Prontera.
scripts.translation:
[提亚尔菲]
哦，对了，请先去和我姐姐罗丝克瓦对话。她在普隆德拉北门外面。

scripts.text:
[Tialfi]
I'm sure that she can
give you useful information if you're fortunate enough to encounter the Dwarves.
scripts.translation:
[提亚尔菲]
她肯定能告诉你一些有用的事，让你有幸遇到矮人时，知道该怎么做。

scripts.text:
[Tialfi]
I'm truly lucky to meet such an adventurer like yourself. I wish you the best of luck.
scripts.translation:
[提亚尔菲]
能遇到像你这样的冒险者，我真的很幸运。祝你一路顺风。

scripts.text:
[Tialfi]
I believe in you.
Just be courageous!
scripts.translation:
[提亚尔菲]
我相信你。
只要勇敢一点就好！

scripts.text:
[Roskva]
You should know that Dwarven Blacksmiths are extremely offended if you do not speak to them with the utmost respect.
scripts.translation:
[罗丝克瓦]
矮人铁匠非常看重礼数。
跟他们说话，要是有半点不敬，他们可是会发怒的。

scripts.text:
[Roskva]
So it's really
important that you
speak to the Dwarves
as courteously as you can.
The first Dwarf you must visit
can be found to the East.
scripts.translation:
[罗丝克瓦]
所以，尽可能礼貌地与矮人对话非常重要。
你要拜访的第一位矮人在东方。

scripts.text:
[Roskva]
Travel in a clock wise direction around Midgard and seek out the other Dwarves in order. Your final destination will be to the North.
scripts.translation:
[罗丝克瓦]
请沿顺时针方向绕米德加尔特行进，按顺序寻找其他矮人。你的最终目的地在北方。

scripts.text:
[Roskva]
If you happen to speak to them in the wrong order, please go talk to my brother Tialfi again.
scripts.translation:
[罗丝克瓦]
要是不小心弄错了拜访顺序，就再回去找提亚尔菲吧。

scripts.text:
[Roskva]
You should know that Dwarven Blacksmiths are extremely offended if you do not speak to them with the utmost respect.
scripts.translation:
[罗丝克瓦]
矮人铁匠非常看重礼数。
跟他们说话，要是有半点不敬，他们可是会发怒的。

scripts.text:
[Roskva]
So it's really
important that you
speak to the Dwarves
as courteously as you can.
The first Dwarf you must visit
can be found to the North.
scripts.translation:
[罗丝克瓦]
所以，尽可能礼貌地与矮人对话非常重要。
你要拜访的第一位矮人在北方。

scripts.text:
[Roskva]
Travel in a counter clock wise direction around Midgard and seek out the other Dwarves in order. Your final destination will be to the East.
scripts.translation:
[罗丝克瓦]
请沿逆时针方向绕米德加尔特行进，按顺序寻找其他矮人。你的最终目的地在东方。

scripts.text:
[Roskva]
If you happen to speak to them in the wrong order, please go talk to my brother Tialfi again.
scripts.translation:
[罗丝克瓦]
要是不小心弄错了拜访顺序，就再回去找提亚尔菲吧。

scripts.text:
[Roskva]
A long time ago, many people used to frequent this area. Friends and families would live here, sharing happiness and sadness.
scripts.translation:
[罗丝克瓦]
很久以前，这一带常有人来往。
亲朋好友住在这里，有福同享，有难同当。

scripts.text:
[Roskva]
But they're all gone now. My parents and my friends have all gone to a place whose name I don't even know.
scripts.translation:
[罗丝克瓦]
但现在他们都走了。我的父母和朋友们都去了一个我甚至不知道名字的地方。

scripts.text:
[Roskva]
I can't help
but feel lonesome...
scripts.translation:
[罗丝克瓦]
我忍不住感到孤独...

scripts.text:
[Austri]
Something is happening somewhere on this continent. You might not believe me, but I keep getting visions of the Fenrir-Wolf.
scripts.translation:
[奥斯特里]
这片大陆的某处正在发生着什么。你可能不信，但我不断看到芬里尔之狼的幻象。

scripts.text:
[Austri]
Something is happening somewhere on this continent. You might not believe me, but I keep getting visions of the Fenrir-Wolf.
scripts.translation:
[奥斯特里]
这片大陆的某处正在发生着什么。你可能不信，但我不断看到芬里尔之狼的幻象。

scripts.text:
[Austri]
When my people finally retrieve the memories of their past, we will be able to grant the power of the gods to humans.
scripts.translation:
[奥斯特里]
当我的族人最终找回过去的记忆时，我们将能够赋予人类神的力量。

scripts.text:
[Austri]
I believe that
time is coming...
scripts.translation:
[奥斯特里]
我相信那个时刻就要到了...

scripts.text:
[Austri]
Hm? I sense that you were asked to do a favor for that human. If I were you, I'd finish that task as soon as I could. Somehow, that human's fate, as well as that of the Dwarves, are intertwined...
scripts.translation:
[奥斯特里]
嗯？感觉是那个人类请你来帮忙的。
换作是我，就尽快把事情办妥。
不知为何，那个人类的命运，竟跟我们矮人紧紧相连...

scripts.text:
[Austri]
What is it?! I refuse to speak to human as rude and contemptible
as you! Now, get out of my sight!
scripts.translation:
[奥斯特里]
什么？！
你这种粗鲁可鄙的人类，我没什么好说的！
滚出我的视线！

scripts.text:
[Austri]
What...?
I have nothing
to say to you.
scripts.translation:
[奥斯特里]
什么...？
我没什么想对你说的。

scripts.text:
[Austri]
Hm...?
Why have you
come to me, human?
scripts.translation:
[奥斯特里]
嗯...？
你为何来找我，人类？

scripts.text: Nothing.
scripts.translation: 没什么

scripts.text: Hey, 'sup!
scripts.translation: 嘿，你好啊！

scripts.text:
[Austri]
...
scripts.translation:
[奥斯特里]
...

scripts.text:
[Austri]
What...?!
Do not greet the
Dwarves lightly,
mortal!
scripts.translation:
[奥斯特里]
什么？！
凡人，跟矮人打招呼，岂能如此轻慢！

scripts.text:
[Austri]
What has made
you come to me?
scripts.translation:
[奥斯特里]
是什么事让你来找我？

scripts.text: Nothing.
scripts.translation: 没什么

scripts.text: Excuse me, sir.
scripts.translation: 打扰了，先生

scripts.text:
[Austri]
...
scripts.translation:
[奥斯特里]
...

scripts.text:
[Austri]
Ah, I see that the entire human race is not worthy of scorn. Unlike many of your kind, I see that you respect your elders.
scripts.translation:
[奥斯特里]
啊，原来人类也不全都令人鄙夷。
和你许多同类不同，你倒是懂得尊敬长者。

scripts.text:
[Austri]
So what did
want to ask
me about?
scripts.translation:
[奥斯特里]
那么你想问我什么？

scripts.text: About Mjolnir.
scripts.translation: 关于雷神之锤

scripts.text:
[Austri]
Mjolnir...?
Thor's legendary weapon?
The hammer than can shake the earth and tear the sky asunder? Out of all of legendary weapons, Mjolnir is perhaps greatest.
scripts.translation:
[奥斯特里]
雷神之锤...？
托尔那把传说中的武器？
能撼动大地、撕裂天空的神锤？
诸般传奇兵器里，它或许当属第一。

scripts.text:
[Austri]
As a matter of fact, it was forged by my ancestor. Mjolnir was the perfect weapon, except for one minor flaw.
scripts.translation:
[奥斯特里]
实不相瞒，那是我祖先打造的。
除了一个小小的缺陷，雷神之锤堪称完美。

scripts.text:
[Austri]
The hilt of Mjolnir was forged shorter than intended. Are you still listening to me?
scripts.translation:
[奥斯特里]
锤柄比原本打算的短了些。
你还在听吗？

scripts.text: Yes, sir!
scripts.translation: 是的，先生！

scripts.text: Huh?
scripts.translation: 咦？

scripts.text:
[Austri]
One day, Loki came to our village and showed off his treasures. He boasted that we couldn't possibly create something to surpass their quality.
scripts.translation:
[奥斯特里]
有一天，洛基来到我们的村庄，炫耀他的宝物。他吹嘘我们不可能创造出超越它们品质的东西。

scripts.text:
[Austri]
Frankly his treasures were
made by another Dwarf tribe, but we couldn't tolerate his insult. So my ancestors created three treasures of their own.
scripts.translation:
[奥斯特里]
其实，他那些宝物也是另一支矮人部族打造的，可我们受不了这份羞辱。
于是，祖先们又打造出了三件宝物。

scripts.text: Boooring!
scripts.translation: 好无聊！

scripts.text: Oh, wow.
scripts.translation: 哇，好厉害

scripts.text:
[Austri]
Of the three treasures my ancestors created, Mjolnir was the last and greatest.
scripts.translation:
[奥斯特里]

Ah...
It feels like today's going to be a great day.
scripts.translation:
[奥斯特里]
啊...
感觉今天会是美好的一天。

scripts.text:
[Austri]
I've got the warm sun, fresh forest air, and my hammer and anvil are at the ready. It's a perfect day for smithing!
scripts.translation:
[奥斯特里]
阳光暖和，林间空气清新，锤子和铁砧也都齐备。

scripts.text:

呼...呼...

and fight with stronger and stronger opponents!
scripts.translation:

我要跟越来越强的对手较量！

scripts.translation: 苏德里获胜！

scripts.text:
[Sudri]
Muhahahaha!
You're not strong enough to beat me! I want someone who can offer
me a challenge!
scripts.translation:
[苏德里]
哇哈哈哈！
想打败我，你还不够强！
我要的，是能让我痛快打一场的对手！

scripts.text:
[Sudri]
Go out, train some and get stronger before you even think about coming back!
scripts.translation:
[苏德里]
出去练练，变强了再来找我吧！

scripts.text:
[Sudri]
You're stronger than me. I never thought I'd meet a human as strong as you.
scripts.translation:
[苏德里]
你比我强。
我没想到会遇到像你这么强的人类。

scripts.text:
[Sudri]
I'm impressed! Alright, I'll tell my friends good things about you. Hopefully, my brothers will give you the help you're looking for.
scripts.translation:
[苏德里]
真让我佩服！
好，我会向朋友们夸夸你。
希望我的兄弟们，能帮上你想办的事。

scripts.text:
[Sudri]
Okay then,
be safe on
your travels!
scripts.translation:
[苏德里]
那么，旅途平安！

scripts.text:
[Sudri]
So...
What brings
you here, human?
scripts.translation:
[苏德里]
那么...
人类，你来这里做什么？

scripts.text: Nothing.
scripts.translation: 没什么

scripts.text: Excuse me, sir.
scripts.translation: 打扰了，先生

scripts.text:
[Sudri]
You have too much time on your hands. Why don't you log out and hang out with your buddies for a while?
scripts.translation:
[苏德里]
你闲得发慌了。
不如下线去跟你的朋友们聚聚？

scripts.text:
[Sudri]
Huh. You're different than other humans. But still, trusting you because you know how to speak respectfully isn't very wise.
scripts.translation:
[苏德里]
哼。你和其他人类不太一样。
不过，仅仅因为你懂礼貌就信任你，这可不是什么明智之举。

scripts.text:
[Sudri]
If there's anything I love,
it's bare knuckle brawling,
old school style.
scripts.translation:
[苏德里]
我最爱的，就是赤手空拳，按老规矩狠狠干一架。

scripts.text:
[Sudri]
Words can be deceptive,
but if you can beat me in
a fight, I think I might
just talk to you.
How about it?
scripts.translation:
[苏德里]
嘴上说的未必可信。
不过，要是你能打赢我，我倒可以跟你谈谈。
怎么样？

scripts.text: Yes, I accept your challenge.
scripts.translation: 好，我接受挑战

scripts.text: No, I'm scared!
scripts.translation: 不，我害怕了！

scripts.text:
[Sudri]
You didn't
even answer me!
Fine! Whatever!
scripts.translation:
[苏德里]
你甚至都没回答我！
算了！随你便！

scripts.text:
[Sudri]
Ah, I like you already, human! Now why don't you go do some warm ups, and we'll fight when you're ready.
scripts.translation:
[苏德里]
啊，我已经开始喜欢你了，人类！
现在，你不妨去热热身，等你准备好了我们再打。

scripts.text:
[Sudri]
Eh...?
Why are you being
such a coward?
Are you afraid of
this old and tiny Dwarf?
scripts.translation:
[苏德里]
呃...？
你为什么这么胆小？
你是怕我这个又老又小的矮人吗？

scripts.text:
[Sudri]
Come on, I'll even let you have the first hit. Just come to me when you're ready to fight!
scripts.translation:
[苏德里]
来吧，我甚至会让你先出手。
等你准备好战斗了就来找我！

scripts.text:
[Sudri]
Zzzz Zzzz...

[Sudri]
[Sudri]
Get out of here before I beat you to death! All you can gain over here is a few herbs, anyway!
scripts.translation:
[苏德里]
[苏德里]
在我把你打死之前赶紧滚！
反正你在这里只能采到几株草药而已！

scripts.text:
[Sudri]
That was a great fight!
Hahahahahahahahahaah!
I regret nothing.
I may have lost, but
I gave it my all!
scripts.translation:
[苏德里]
打得痛快！
哈哈哈哈哈哈！
我没有遗憾。
虽然输了，可我已经拼尽全力！

scripts.text:
[Sudri]
What made you come to me?
scripts.translation:
[苏德里]
是什么让你来找我的？

scripts.text: Nothing.
scripts.translation: 没什么

scripts.text: Excuse me, sir.
scripts.translation: 打扰了，先生

scripts.text:
[Sudri]
You have too much
time on your hands.
Why don't you log out and go out with your friends instead?
scripts.translation:
[苏德里]
你闲得发慌了。
不如下线去跟你的朋友们聚聚？

scripts.text:
[Sudri]
Why should
I excuse you?
Do you want to
fight with me, huh?
scripts.translation:
[苏德里]
我凭什么要原谅你？
怎么，想跟我打一场？

scripts.text:
[Sudri]
Cool, let's fight!
scripts.translation:
[苏德里]
好，那就打吧！

scripts.translation: 苏德里获胜！

scripts.text:
[Sudri]
Muhahahaha!
You're not strong enough to beat me! I want someone who can offer
me a challenge!
scripts.translation:
[苏德里]
哇哈哈哈！
想打败我，你还不够强！
我要的，是能让我痛快打一场的对手！

scripts.text:
[Sudri]
Go out, train some and get stronger before you even think about coming back!
scripts.translation:
[苏德里]
出去练练，变强了再来找我吧！

scripts.text:
[Sudri]
You're stronger than me. I never thought I'd meet a human as strong as you.
scripts.translation:
[苏德里]
你比我强。
我没想到会遇到像你这么强的人类。

scripts.text:
[Sudri]
I'm impressed! Alright, I'll tell my friends good things about you. Hopefully, my brothers will give you the help you're looking for.
scripts.translation:
[苏德里]
真让我佩服！
好，我会向朋友们夸夸你。
希望我的兄弟们，能帮上你想办的事。

scripts.text:
[Sudri]
Okay then,
be safe on
your travels!
scripts.translation:
[苏德里]
那么，旅途平安！

scripts.text:
[Sudri]
What made you come to me?
scripts.translation:
[苏德里]
是什么让你来找我的？

scripts.text: Nothing.
scripts.translation: 没什么

scripts.text: Excuse me, sir.
scripts.translation: 打扰了，先生

scripts.text:
[Sudri]
You have too much
time on your hands.
Why don't you log out and go out with your friends instead?
scripts.translation:
[苏德里]
你闲得发慌了。
不如下线去跟你的朋友们聚聚？

scripts.text:
[Sudri]
Huh. You're different than other humans. But still, trusting you because you know how to speak respectfully isn't very wise.
scripts.translation:
[苏德里]
哼。你和其他人类不太一样。
不过，仅仅因为你懂礼貌就信任你，这可不是什么明智之举。

scripts.text:
[Sudri]
If there's anything I love,
it's bare knuckle brawling,
old school style.
scripts.translation:
[苏德里]
我最爱的，就是赤手空拳，按老规矩狠狠干一架。

scripts.text:
[Sudri]
Words can be deceptive,
but if you can beat me in
a fight, I think I might
just talk to you.
How about it?
scripts.translation:
[苏德里]
嘴上说的未必可信。
不过，要是你能打赢我，我倒可以跟你谈谈。
怎么样？

scripts.text: Yes, I accept your challenge.
scripts.translation: 好，我接受挑战

scripts.text: No, I'm scared!
scripts.translation: 不，我害怕了！

scripts.text:
[Sudri]
You didn't
even answer me!
Fine! Whatever!
scripts.translation:
[苏德里]
你甚至都没回答我！
算了！随你便！

scripts.text:
[Sudri]
Ah, I like you already, human! Now why don't you go do some warm ups, and we'll fight when you're ready.
scripts.translation:
[苏德里]
啊，我已经开始喜欢你了，人类！
现在，你不妨去热热身，等你准备好了我们再打。

scripts.text:
[Sudri]
Eh...?
Why are you being
such a coward?
Are you afraid of
this old and tiny Dwarf?
scripts.translation:
[苏德里]
呃...？
你为什么这么胆小？
你是怕我这个又老又小的矮人吗？

scripts.text:
[Sudri]
Come on, I'll even let you have the first hit. Just come to me when you're ready to fight!
scripts.translation:
[苏德里]
来吧，我甚至会让你先出手。
等你准备好战斗了就来找我！

scripts.text:
[Sudri]
Zzzz Zzzz...

[Sudri]
In a one on one fight, you put everything on the line to show your might to your opponent.
scripts.translation:
[苏德里]
一对一较量，就得豁出一切，让对手见识自己的力量。

scripts.text:
[Sudri]
Have you ever felt the same way I do, human? Win or lose, just giving your all is the most satisfying accomplishment.
scripts.translation:
[苏德里]
人类，你也有过这样的感觉吗？
不论胜负，只要倾尽全力，就是最大的满足。

scripts.text:
[Sudri]
Zzzz Zzzz...

[Vestri]
If you want something, you should earn it through your own efforts.
scripts.translation:
[韦斯特里]
如果你想要什么，就应该靠自己的努力去争取。

scripts.text:
[Vestri]
No matter what other people say, if you're confident and your will is unwavering, you'll always be satisfied with the results.
scripts.translation:
[韦斯特里]
不管别人说什么，只要相信自己、意志坚定，就一定能坦然接受结果。

scripts.text:
[Vestri]
What do you think?
Kids these days...
scripts.translation:
[韦斯特里]
你觉得呢？
现在的年轻人啊...

scripts.text:
[Vestri]
I don't feel
like doing anything
today. Anything at all...
scripts.translation:
[韦斯特里]
我今天什么都不想做。
什么都...不想做...

scripts.text:
[Vestri]
Someone must have forged something really monstrous, otherwise I wouldn't be feeling so worthless!
scripts.translation:
[韦斯特里]
一定是有人锻造出了惊世之作，不然我怎么会觉得自己这么没用！

scripts.text:
[Vestri]
Yeah, I think I need a break! Don't you think I need a break, human?
scripts.translation:
[韦斯特里]
是啊，我觉得我需要休息一下！
你不觉得我也该休息一下吗，人类？

scripts.text:
[Vestri]
There's nothing like taking a relaxing break after putting your heart into your work.
scripts.translation:
[韦斯特里]
全心投入工作后，没有什么比放松休息更惬意的了。

scripts.text:
[Vestri]
What do you think,
human? Isn't that one
of life's simple pleasures?
scripts.translation:
[韦斯特里]
你觉得呢，人类？
这不是生活中简单的乐趣之一吗？

scripts.text:
[Vestri]
If you want something, you should earn it through your own efforts.
scripts.translation:
[韦斯特里]
如果你想要什么，就应该靠自己的努力去争取。

scripts.text:
[Vestri]
No matter what other people say, if you're confident and your will is unwavering, you'll always be satisfied with the results.
scripts.translation:
[韦斯特里]
不管别人说什么，只要相信自己、意志坚定，就一定能坦然接受结果。

scripts.text:
[Vestri]
What do you think?
Kids these days...
scripts.translation:
[韦斯特里]
你觉得呢？
现在的年轻人啊...

scripts.text:
[Vestri]
I really hope I meet a decent human being next time. So far, I haven't met one useful human.
scripts.translation:
[韦斯特里]
真希望下次能遇到个靠谱的人类。
到目前为止，我还没遇到过有用的人类。

scripts.text:
[Vestri]
Perfect preparation does not always result in success. There's a point when you've got to just go out and do it.
scripts.translation:
[韦斯特里]
完美的准备并不总能带来成功。
到了某个时刻，你就必须放手一搏。

scripts.text:
[Vestri]
I don't know how
big your goals are,
but put your heart into
whatever it is that you
plan to accomplish in life.
scripts.translation:
[韦斯特里]
不知道你的志向有多远大，不过不管想做成什么，都要全力以赴。

scripts.text:
[Vestri]
What do you want?
scripts.translation:
[韦斯特里]
你想要什么？

scripts.text: Nothing.
scripts.translation: 没什么

scripts.text: Excuse me.
scripts.translation: 打扰一下

scripts.text:
[Vestri]
If you want something, you should earn it through your own efforts.
scripts.translation:
[韦斯特里]
如果你想要什么，就应该靠自己的努力去争取。

scripts.text:
[Vestri]
No matter what other people say, if you're confident and your will is unwavering, you'll always be satisfied with the results.
scripts.translation:
[韦斯特里]
不管别人说什么，只要相信自己、意志坚定，就一定能坦然接受结果。

scripts.text:
[Vestri]
You didn't answer the question! Now, you've probably got the wrong Dwarf here...
scripts.translation:
[韦斯特里]
你没有回答问题！
现在，你大概找错矮人了吧...

scripts.text:
[Vestri]
Get out of here, and go to your human Blacksmiths if you want equipment upgrades!
scripts.translation:
[韦斯特里]
出去！
想精炼装备，找你们人类自己的铁匠去！

scripts.text:
[Vestri]
Great...!
Which one should I upgrade first, huh? My heart is pounding with anticipation...
scripts.translation:
[韦斯特里]
好...！
先精炼哪件呢？
真期待，心都怦怦跳起来了...

scripts.text:
[Vestri]
What...?!
This isn't upgradable!
What the hell do you want
me to do with this?
scripts.translation:
[韦斯特里]
什么...？！
这根本没法精炼！
你他妈想让我拿它做什么？

scripts.text:
[Vestri]
Oh, this is excellent! This piece here has been perfectly refined! But this isn't what I want. I can't do any work on this at all.
scripts.translation:
[韦斯特里]
哦，好东西！
这件已经精炼到极致了！
可这不是我想要的，已经没什么能再加工的了。

scripts.text:
[Vestri]
This item isn't even a challenge to upgrade. You can get humans to do this kind of beginner's stuff. Get them to refine it first.
scripts.translation:
[韦斯特里]
这东西精炼起来，根本谈不上挑战。
这种入门的活计，找人类做就够了。
让他们先精炼一下再来。

scripts.text:
[Vestri]
Come on...
Bring me something
that presents an
element of risk!
scripts.translation:
[韦斯特里]
拜托...
给我拿点有风险的东西来！

scripts.text:
[Vestri]
Armor?!
Didn't I tell
you that I only work
on Level 4 weapons?
scripts.translation:
[韦斯特里]
防具？！
不是说了，我只精炼4级武器吗？

scripts.text:
[Vestri]
You can have a human
Blacksmith work on that kind of stuff! Now, a Dwarf like me needs something that's more of a challenge!
scripts.translation:
[韦斯特里]
这种活儿你去找人类铁匠做吧！像我这样的矮人，需要的是更有挑战性的工作！

scripts.text:
[Vestri]
Hey...
Don't insult me by expecting me to work on anything less than a Level 4 weapon.
scripts.translation:
[韦斯特里]
喂...
别拿4级以下的武器来侮辱我。

scripts.text:
[Vestri]
Bring me a Level 4 weapon for me to work on next time, got it?
scripts.translation:
[韦斯特里]
下次记得带4级武器来，听到了吗？

scripts.text:
[Vestri]
Okay, let me give you the mandatory warning. If your weapon happens to be destroyed by chance during the upgrade, you'll never see the weapon again.
scripts.translation:
[韦斯特里]
先按规矩提醒你一句：精炼若是失败，武器损坏了，就再也拿不回来了。

scripts.text:
[Vestri]
That also means that if the weapon is destroyed, any ^FF0000Cards^000000 inserted into the weapon will also be gone.
scripts.translation:
[韦斯特里]
也就是说，如果武器被毁，插在里面的^FF0000卡片^000000也会一起消失。

scripts.text:
[Vestri]
If you understand,
then let's get on with it!
scripts.translation:
[韦斯特里]
如果你明白了，那就开始吧！

scripts.text: Sure, let's do it!
scripts.translation: 好的，开始吧！

scripts.text: N-no, I changed my mind!
scripts.translation: 不、不，我改主意了！

scripts.text:
[Vestri]
Bah...!
How do you survive
in this world with that
kind of cowardice?!
scripts.translation:
[韦斯特里]
哼...！
像你这种胆小鬼，是怎么在这个世界活下来的？！

scripts.text:
[Vestri]
Oh, forget it.
I know you're just being careful. Damn, I was just so eager to get
to work!
scripts.translation:
[韦斯特里]
算了。
我知道你只是比较谨慎。该死，我还正急着开工呢！

scripts.text:
[Vestri]
Huh...
You forgot to
bring an Oridecon.
Hurry up and get one.
scripts.translation:
[韦斯特里]
咦...
你忘了带神之金属。
快去弄一个来。

scripts.text: ^3355FF*Clang Clang!*^000000

[Vestri]
Mwahahaha~
I've still got it!
So aren't you happy
with an even more
powerful weapon?
scripts.translation:
[韦斯特里]
哇哈哈哈~
我的手艺还没退步！
武器更强了，高兴吧？

scripts.text:
[Vestri]
^3355FF*Clang Clang!*^000000

[Vestri]
Waaahhhhh!
Dear God, no!
scripts.translation:
[韦斯特里]
哇！
天哪，不！

scripts.text:
[Vestri]
I-It's alright!
Bad things happen
sometimes. Let's just
think of it as both us
of us having a bad day.
Yeah, no regrets!
scripts.translation:
[韦斯特里]
没、没事！
人总有倒霉的时候，就当咱俩今天运气都不佳。
没错，别后悔！

scripts.text:
[Vestri]
Well, my friend,
if you ever visit my brothers, please give them my regards.
Take care.
scripts.translation:
[韦斯特里]
好了，朋友，如果你以后去拜访我的兄弟们，请代我向他们问好。
保重。

scripts.text:

scripts.translation:
[韦斯特里]
你想要什么？

scripts.text: Nothing.
scripts.translation: 没什么

scripts.text: Excuse me.
scripts.translation: 打扰一下

scripts.text:

如果你想要什么，就应该靠自己的努力去争取。

scripts.text:
[Vestri]

scripts.translation:
[韦斯特里]
不管别人说什么，只要相信自己、意志坚定，就一定能坦然接受结果。

scripts.text:
[Vestri]
Huh...
I don't know how I can be much help to an adventurer like you. Aside from being a Blacksmith...
scripts.translation:
[韦斯特里]
咦...
除了当铁匠之外，我不知道还能怎么帮到你这样的冒险者。

scripts.text:
[Vestri]
There's nothing I enjoy more than upgrading high level weapons that are on the verge of breaking.
scripts.translation:
[韦斯特里]
我最享受的，就是精炼那些再进一步就可能损坏的高等级武器。

scripts.text:
[Vestri]
Don't you like the idea of challenging the limit? To me, upgrading feels like climbing unconquered mountains!
scripts.translation:
[韦斯特里]
挑战极限，多痛快！
对我而言，精炼武器就像攀登尚无人登顶的高峰！

scripts.text:
[Vestri]
Alright. Perhaps I'm meant to help you out, so I'll upgrade a weapon for you. All you need to do is bring me the weapon and material.
scripts.translation:
[韦斯特里]
好吧。也许我命中注定要帮你的忙，那我就帮你精炼一把武器吧。你只需要把武器和材料带给我就行。

scripts.text:
[Vestri]
Here's the condition: You've got to bring me a Level 4 Weapon that's been upgraded to the point where it might break. Oh, and bring an Oridecon!
scripts.translation:
[韦斯特里]
有个条件：带一把已经精炼到有损坏风险的4级武器来。
哦，还要一个神之金属！

scripts.text:
[Vestri]
Zzzz Zzzz Zzzz...

[Vestri]
I really hope I meet a decent human being next time. So far, I haven't met one useful human.
scripts.translation:
[韦斯特里]
真希望下次能遇到个靠谱的人类。
到目前为止，我还没遇到过有用的人类。

scripts.text:
[Vestri]
Perfect preparation does not always result in success. There's a point when you've got to just go out and do it.
scripts.translation:
[韦斯特里]
完美的准备并不总能带来成功。
到了某个时刻，你就必须放手一搏。

scripts.text:
[Vestri]
I don't know how
big your goals are,
but put your heart into
whatever it is that you
plan to accomplish in life.
scripts.translation:
[韦斯特里]
不知道你的志向有多远大，不过不管想做成什么，都要全力以赴。

scripts.text:
[Vestri]
What do you want?
scripts.translation:
[韦斯特里]
你想要什么？

scripts.text: Nothing.
scripts.translation: 没什么

scripts.text: Excuse me.
scripts.translation: 打扰一下

scripts.text:
[Vestri]
If you want something, you should earn it through your own efforts.
scripts.translation:
[韦斯特里]
如果你想要什么，就应该靠自己的努力去争取。

scripts.text:
[Vestri]
No matter what other people say, if you're confident and your will is unwavering, you'll always be satisfied with the results.
scripts.translation:
[韦斯特里]
不管别人说什么，只要相信自己、意志坚定，就一定能坦然接受结果。

scripts.text:
[Vestri]
You didn't answer the question! Now, you've probably got the wrong Dwarf here...
scripts.translation:
[韦斯特里]
你没有回答问题！
现在，你大概找错矮人了吧...

scripts.text:
[Vestri]
Get out of here, and go to your human Blacksmiths if you want equipment upgrades!
scripts.translation:
[韦斯特里]
出去！
想精炼装备，找你们人类自己的铁匠去！

scripts.text:
[Vestri]
Great...!
Which one should I upgrade first, huh? My heart is pounding with anticipation...
scripts.translation:
[韦斯特里]
好...！
先精炼哪件呢？
真期待，心都怦怦跳起来了...

scripts.text:
[Vestri]
What...?!
This isn't upgradable!
What the hell do you want
me to do with this?
scripts.translation:
[韦斯特里]
什么...？！
这根本没法精炼！
你他妈想让我拿它做什么？

scripts.text:
[Vestri]
Oh, this is excellent! This piece here has been perfectly refined! But this isn't what I want. I can't do any work on this at all.
scripts.translation:
[韦斯特里]
哦，好东西！
这件已经精炼到极致了！
可这不是我想要的，已经没什么能再加工的了。

scripts.text:
[Vestri]
This item isn't even a challenge to upgrade. You can get humans to do this kind of beginner's stuff. Get them to refine it first.
scripts.translation:
[韦斯特里]
这东西精炼起来，根本谈不上挑战。
这种入门的活计，找人类做就够了。
让他们先精炼一下再来。

scripts.text:
[Vestri]
Come on...
Bring me something
that presents an
element of risk!
scripts.translation:
[韦斯特里]
拜托...
给我拿点有风险的东西来！

scripts.text:
[Vestri]
Armor?!
Didn't I tell
you that I only work
on Level 4 weapons?
scripts.translation:
[韦斯特里]
防具？！
不是说了，我只精炼4级武器吗？

scripts.text:
[Vestri]
Hey...
Don't insult me by expecting me to work on anything less than a Level 4 weapon.
scripts.translation:
[韦斯特里]
喂...
别拿4级以下的武器来侮辱我。

scripts.text:
[Vestri]
Bring me a Level 4 weapon for me to work on next time, got it?
scripts.translation:
[韦斯特里]
下次记得带4级武器来，听到了吗？

scripts.text:
[Vestri]
Okay, let me give you the mandatory warning. If your weapon happens to be destroyed by chance during the upgrade, you'll never see the weapon again.
scripts.translation:
[韦斯特里]
先按规矩提醒你一句：精炼若是失败，武器损坏了，就再也拿不回来了。

scripts.text:
[Vestri]
That also means that if the weapon is destroyed, any ^FF0000Cards^000000 inserted into the weapon will also be gone.
scripts.translation:
[韦斯特里]
也就是说，如果武器被毁，插在里面的^FF0000卡片^000000也会一起消失。

scripts.text:
[Vestri]
If you understand,
then let's get on with it!
scripts.translation:
[韦斯特里]
如果你明白了，那就开始吧！

scripts.text: Sure, let's do it!
scripts.translation: 好的，开始吧！

scripts.text: ...no, I am out.
scripts.translation: ...不，我拒绝

scripts.text:
[Vestri]
Bah...!
How do you survive
in this world with that
kind of cowardice?!
scripts.translation:
[韦斯特里]
哼...！
像你这种胆小鬼，是怎么在这个世界活下来的？！

scripts.text:
[Vestri]
Oh, forget it.
I know you're just being careful. Damn, I was just so eager to get
to work!
scripts.translation:
[韦斯特里]
算了。
我知道你只是比较谨慎。该死，我还正急着开工呢！

scripts.text:
[Vestri]
Huh...
You forgot to
bring an Oridecon.
Hurry up and get one.
scripts.translation:
[韦斯特里]
咦...
你忘了带神之金属。
快去弄一个来。

scripts.text: ^3355FF*Clang Clang!*^000000

[Vestri]
Mwahahaha~
I've still got it!
So aren't you happy
with an even more
powerful weapon?
scripts.translation:
[韦斯特里]
哇哈哈哈~
我的手艺还没退步！
武器更强了，高兴吧？

scripts.text:
[Vestri]
^3355FF*Clang Clang!*^000000

[Vestri]
Waaahhhhh!
Dear God, no!
scripts.translation:
[韦斯特里]
哇！
天哪，不！

scripts.text:
[Vestri]
I-It's alright!
Bad things happen
sometimes. Let's just
think of it as both us
of us having a bad day.
Yeah, no regrets!
scripts.translation:
[韦斯特里]
没、没事！
人总有倒霉的时候，就当咱俩今天运气都不佳。
没错，别后悔！

scripts.text:
[Vestri]
Well, my friend,
if you ever visit my brothers, please give them my regards.
Take care.
scripts.translation:
[韦斯特里]
好了，朋友，如果你以后去拜访我的兄弟们，请代我向他们问好。
保重。

scripts.text:
[Vestri]
What do you want?
scripts.translation:
[韦斯特里]
你想要什么？

scripts.text: Nothing.
scripts.translation: 没什么

scripts.text: Excuse me.
scripts.translation: 打扰一下

scripts.text:
[Vestri]
If you want something, you should earn it through your own efforts.
scripts.translation:
[韦斯特里]
如果你想要什么，就应该靠自己的努力去争取。

scripts.text:
[Vestri]
No matter what other people say, if you're confident and your will is unwavering, you'll always be satisfied with the results.
scripts.translation:
[韦斯特里]
不管别人说什么，只要相信自己、意志坚定，就一定能坦然接受结果。

scripts.text:
[Vestri]
Huh...
I don't know how I can be much help to an adventurer like you. Aside from being a Blacksmith...
scripts.translation:
[韦斯特里]
咦...
除了当铁匠之外，我不知道还能怎么帮到你这样的冒险者。

scripts.text:
[Vestri]
There's nothing I enjoy more than upgrading high level weapons that are on the verge of breaking.
scripts.translation:
[韦斯特里]
我最享受的，就是精炼那些再进一步就可能损坏的高等级武器。

scripts.text:
[Vestri]
Don't you like the idea of challenging the limit? To me, upgrading feels like climbing unconquered mountains!
scripts.translation:
[韦斯特里]
挑战极限，多痛快！
对我而言，精炼武器就像攀登尚无人登顶的高峰！

scripts.text:
[Vestri]
Alright. Perhaps I'm meant to help you out, so I'll upgrade a weapon for you. All you need to do is bring me the weapon and material.
scripts.translation:
[韦斯特里]
好吧。也许我命中注定要帮你的忙，那我就帮你精炼一把武器吧。你只需要把武器和材料带给我就行。

scripts.text:
[Vestri]
Here's the condition: You've got to bring me a Level 4 Weapon that's been upgraded to the point where it might break. Oh, and bring an Oridecon!
scripts.translation:
[韦斯特里]
有个条件：带一把已经精炼到有损坏风险的4级武器来。
哦，还要一个神之金属！

scripts.text:
[Vestri]
Zzzz Zzzz Zzzz...

[Vestri]
It's always a pleasure to engage myself in hard work, especially smithing.
scripts.translation:
[韦斯特里]
从事艰苦的工作总是令人愉悦的，尤其是打铁。

scripts.text:
[Vestri]
Upgrading is always enjoyable!
I have no regrets when failure, and I'm always pleased when I'm successful. I'll upgrade everyday to make the best of my life~
scripts.translation:
[韦斯特里]
精炼总是那么有趣！
失败也不后悔，成功更是开心。
每天都打打铁、精炼精炼武器，日子才过得有滋味~

scripts.text:
[Vestri]
Zzzz Zzzz Zzzz...

[Nordri]
What...?
I don't have any
Eluniums or Oridecons!
scripts.translation:
[诺德里]
什...么？
我这里没有铝，也没有神之金属！

scripts.text:
[Nordri]
Vestri took them all. ^333333*Sigh*^000000 Those were my treasures, you know...
scripts.translation:
[诺德里]
都被韦斯特里拿走了。^333333*叹气*^000000 那可是我的宝贝啊...

scripts.text:
[Nordri]
What's happening?
I sense change in the winds, but what that change may be, I cannot tell.
scripts.translation:
[诺德里]
发生什么事了？
我感觉到风中有变化，但具体是什么变化，我还说不清。

scripts.text:
[Nordri]
Should I go into the cave to figure it out? Huh. This is most peculiar.
scripts.translation:
[诺德里]
我该去洞穴里弄清楚吗？嗯。这真是奇怪。

scripts.text:
[Nordri]
Bwahahah!
Even the gods know that we Dwarves are the most talented of artisans! Maybe it doesn't seem that way now, but someday we shall return.
scripts.translation:
[诺德里]
哇哈哈！
连神都知道，我们矮人是最优秀的工匠！
如今也许不显眼，总有一天我们会重归辉煌。

scripts.text:
[Nordri]
What...?
I don't have any
Eluniums or Oridecons!
scripts.translation:
[诺德里]
什...么？
我这里没有铝，也没有神之金属！

scripts.text:
[Nordri]
Vestri took them all.
Don't you understand?
scripts.translation:
[诺德里]
都被韦斯特里拿走了。
你不明白吗？

scripts.text:
[Nordri]
Eh heh heh~
It's nice being in the Mjolnir Forest. To be surrounded by the quiet, peaceful air and not having to worry about anything...
scripts.translation:
[诺德里]
嘿嘿~
待在妙勒尼森林里，真是舒服。
四周安静祥和，什么也不用操心...

scripts.text:
[Nordri]
Shouldn't you be on your way by now? Eh, it's none of my business.
scripts.translation:
[诺德里]
你不该早就出发了吗？嗯，这也不是我的事。

scripts.text:
[Nordri]
If you have the Zeny to spare, why don't you buy some snacks for your travels? Perhaps some delicious Bananas, or even some Pumpkins...
scripts.translation:
[诺德里]
如果你有多余的Zeny，为什么不买点路上的零食呢？也许是一些美味的香蕉，甚至是南瓜...

scripts.text:
[Nordri]
What business
do you have with
me, human?
scripts.translation:
[诺德里]
你找我有什么事，人类？

scripts.text: Nothing.
scripts.translation: 没什么

scripts.text: Excuse me.
scripts.translation: 打扰一下

scripts.text:
[Nordri]
Huh.
If that's the case,
then leave me alone.
scripts.translation:
[诺德里]
哼。
如果是那样的话，就别来烦我。

scripts.text:
[Nordri]
Huh.
That's fine. Still...
I'm surprised to see
such a polite human.
scripts.translation:
[诺德里]
哼。
那好吧。不过...
见到你这么有礼貌的人类，我有点惊讶。

scripts.text:
[Nordri]
Ah, you've brought
me a Red Potion, just
like I asked. In return,
I will tell you an old story.
I'm sure you'll like it.
scripts.translation:
[诺德里]
啊，你按我说的带了红色药水来。
作为回报，我给你讲个古老的故事。
我相信你会喜欢的。

scripts.text:
[Nordri]
This is a legend about one
of Thor's journeys into Utgard,
land of the giants.
scripts.translation:
[诺德里]
这是关于托尔前往巨人国度乌特加德的一段传说。

scripts.text:
[Nordri]
There, he made a wager with their king in which he would challenge
the giants of their land in tests of skill and strength.
scripts.translation:
[诺德里]
在那里，他与巨人的国王打赌，要挑战那里的巨人们，进行技艺和力量的较量。

scripts.text:
[Nordri]
The first was an eating contest. Thor ate all of the meat on his table, but his opponent, Utgardaloki, ate his meat, the bones and even the plates.
scripts.translation:
[诺德里]
第一项是吃食比赛。托尔吃光了桌上的所有肉，但他的对手乌特加洛基不仅吃了肉，连骨头和盘子都吃了。

scripts.text:
[Nordri]
In truth, Thor was tricked, and the opponent that defeated him was not
actually a giant. Illusion was used to disguise Thor's opponent, but I forget was it was. Do you know?
scripts.translation:
[诺德里]
实际上，托尔被骗了，击败他的对手其实并不是巨人。对手是用幻术伪装出来的，但我忘了那是什么了。你知道吗？

scripts.text: Greed
scripts.translation: 贪婪

scripts.text: Sea
scripts.translation: 大海

scripts.text: Blaze
scripts.translation: 烈焰

scripts.text: Hog
scripts.translation: 野猪

scripts.text:
[Nordri]
Yes, only a Blaze could have effortlessly consumed meat, bones and plates by burning. Of course!
I remember now!
scripts.translation:
[诺德里]
没错，只有烈焰，才能轻易把肉、骨头和盘子全都烧个干净。
对，就是这样，我想起来了！

scripts.text:
[Nordri]
The next contest was a race. In that match, Thor's servant, Tialfi competed with the king's servant, Hugi. However, no matter how many matches they had, Hugi would win every time.
scripts.translation:
[诺德里]
第二项比赛是赛跑。在那场比赛中，托尔的仆人提亚尔菲与国王的仆人胡基进行了较量。然而，无论比了多少次，胡基总是获胜。

scripts.text:
[Nordri]
Once again, illusion magic was
used to disguise the competitor. Do you know what Tialfi was really racing against?
scripts.translation:
[诺德里]
这一次，对手同样是用幻术伪装出来的。你知道提亚尔菲实际上在和谁赛跑吗？

scripts.text: Language
scripts.translation: 语言

scripts.text: Thoughts
scripts.translation: 思想

scripts.text: Turtle
scripts.translation: 乌龟

scripts.text: Wolf
scripts.translation: 狼

scripts.text:
[Nordri]
Yes, right! Tialfi was racing 'thoughts!' Nothing can move faster than the speed of thought, so it's no wonder Tialfi would always lose.
scripts.translation:
[诺德里]
对，提亚尔菲是在跟“思想”赛跑！
什么也快不过念头，难怪他总是输。

scripts.text:
[Nordri]
For the final contest, Thor would challenge an old woman in a wrestling match. At first, Thor thought his victory was assured, but he learned that he could not defeat the old crone.
scripts.translation:
[诺德里]
最后一项比赛，托尔要与一位老妇人进行摔跤。起初，托尔以为胜券在握，但他发现根本无法击败这位老妪。

scripts.text:
[Nordri]
Once again, Thor was the victim
of illusion magic. He didn't realize he wasn't actually wrestling with an old woman. Do you know what his opponent really was?
scripts.translation:
[诺德里]
这一次，托尔又中了幻术。他并没有意识到自己实际上并不是在和一位老妇人摔跤。你知道他的对手真正是什么吗？

scripts.text: Curse
scripts.translation: 诅咒

scripts.text: Earth
scripts.translation: 大地

scripts.text: Heart
scripts.translation: 心

scripts.text: Old Age
scripts.translation: 衰老

scripts.text:
[Nordri]
Yes, Thor was wrestling with 'Old Age!' No matter how strong anybody is, you can't fight against aging.
scripts.translation:
[诺德里]
没错，托尔是在和“衰老”摔跤！无论一个人多么强壮，都无法战胜衰老。

scripts.text:
[Nordri]
After Thor lost every match,
the king told him the truth about the contests. Thor grew furious, but it was too late. The king and the giants all vanished by then.
scripts.translation:
[诺德里]
托尔输掉了所有比赛后，国王告诉他了比赛的真相。托尔勃然大怒，但为时已晚。国王和巨人们全都消失了。

scripts.text:
[Nordri]
There are two lessons
to be learned from this tale. First, don't believe everything you see. Second, never be overconfident of your own power.
scripts.translation:
[诺德里]
这个故事有两个道理。
第一，眼见未必为实。
第二，永远别对自己的力量过分自信。

scripts.text:
[Nordri]
There will always be someone or something more powerful than you. It is important to always do your best and have an attitude of humility.
scripts.translation:
[诺德里]
总会有比你更强大的人或事物存在。保持谦逊的态度，并始终尽力而为，这一点很重要。

scripts.text:
[Nordri]
Try to live as good a life as you can. Remember that you can't have everything that you want. Obssession and irrationality go hand in hand.
scripts.translation:
[诺德里]
尽力做个好人吧，也要记住，不是什么想要的东西都能得到。
执念太深，就容易失去理智。

scripts.text:
[Nordri]
Thank you for listening to my long story. If you meet someone with a dangerous obsession, please tell this story of Thor and the illusions of the giant king.
scripts.translation:
[诺德里]
谢谢你耐心听我讲完。
若遇到有人执迷不悟，眼看就要走上险路，就给他讲讲托尔和巨人王幻术的故事吧。

scripts.text:
[Nordri]
Huh...?
I don't think that's right. Let me think, maybe I can remember it. Hopefully, it'll come to me sooner or later...
scripts.translation:
[诺德里]
嗯...？
好像不对。
让我想想，兴许慢慢就能记起来...

scripts.text:
[Nordri]
Shall we talk more of this once again after enjoying another Red Potion? Hahahahaha~
scripts.translation:
[诺德里]
要不，等我再喝瓶红色药水，咱们接着聊？
哈哈哈哈哈~

scripts.text:
[Nordri]
Oooh...
I'm sooo thirsty!
scripts.translation:
[诺德里]
哦哦...
我渴死了！

scripts.text:
[Nordri]
Hm, didn't I ask you to bring a Red Potion? There's no way I can tell any stories with such a dry throat~
scripts.translation:
[诺德里]
嗯，我不是让你带红色药水来吗？嗓子这么干，我没法讲故事啊~

scripts.text:
[Nordri]
What business
do you have with
me, human?
scripts.translation:
[诺德里]
你找我有什么事，人类？

scripts.text: Nothing.
scripts.translation: 没什么

scripts.text: Excuse me.
scripts.translation: 打扰一下

scripts.text:
[Nordri]
Huh.
If that's the case,
then leave me alone.
scripts.translation:
[诺德里]
哼。
如果是那样的话，就别来烦我。

scripts.text:
[Nordri]
Odd. Recently, too many humans have been interested in meeting with me and my brothers. Still, I cannot say their visits have been unpleasant.
scripts.translation:
[诺德里]
奇怪。最近有太多人类想见我和我的兄弟们了。不过，我也不能说他们的来访不愉快。

scripts.text:
[Nordri]
I'm a little thirsty. Would you bring me a Red Potion. If you do that for me, I will tell you an important story. Heh heh heh~
scripts.translation:
[诺德里]
有点渴，能带瓶红色药水来吗？
作为回报，我给你讲个重要的故事。
嘿嘿嘿~

scripts.text:
[Nordri]
Zzzz Zzzz...

[Nordri]
Eh heh heh~
It's nice being in the Mjolnir Forest. To be surrounded by the quiet, peaceful air and not having to worry about anything...
scripts.translation:
[诺德里]
嘿嘿~
待在妙勒尼森林里，真是舒服。
四周安静祥和，什么也不用操心...

scripts.text:
[Nordri]
Shouldn't you be on your way by now? Eh, it's none of my business.
scripts.translation:
[诺德里]
你不该早就出发了吗？嗯，这也不是我的事。

scripts.text:
[Nordri]
If you have the Zeny to spare, why don't you buy some snacks for your travels? Perhaps some delicious Bananas, or even some Pumpkins...
scripts.translation:
[诺德里]
如果你有多余的Zeny，为什么不买点路上的零食呢？也许是一些美味的香蕉，甚至是南瓜...

scripts.text:
[Nordri]
What business
do you have with
me, human?
scripts.translation:
[诺德里]
你找我有什么事，人类？

scripts.text: Nothing.
scripts.translation: 没什么

scripts.text: Excuse me.
scripts.translation: 打扰一下

scripts.text:
[Nordri]
Huh.
If that's the case,
then leave me alone.
scripts.translation:
[诺德里]
哼。
如果是那样的话，就别来烦我。

scripts.text:
[Nordri]
Huh.
That's fine. Still...
I'm surprised to see
such a polite human.
scripts.translation:
[诺德里]
哼。
那好吧。不过...
见到你这么有礼貌的人类，我有点惊讶。

scripts.text:
[Nordri]
Ah, you've brought
me a Red Potion...?
In return, I will
tell you an old story.
I'm sure you'll like it.
scripts.translation:
[诺德里]
啊，你带了红色药水来...？
作为回报，我会给你讲一个古老的故事。
我相信你会喜欢的。

scripts.text:
[Nordri]
There is a story of a Dwarf named Alvis who contained more knowledge than a library and was braver than Siegfried the warrior.
scripts.translation:
[诺德里]
有个故事，讲的是矮人阿尔维斯。
他的知识比一整座图书馆还丰富，勇气更胜战士齐格飞。

scripts.text:
[Nordri]
Unfortunately...
He was too ambitious.
He fell in love with Thrud, Thor's first daughter, at first sight.
scripts.translation:
[诺德里]
不幸的是...
他太有野心了。
他一见托尔的大女儿特鲁德就爱上了她。

scripts.text:
[Nordri]
He asked Thor for permission to marry Thrud, but as was expected, Thor refused. Alvis should have given up there, but he didn't.
scripts.translation:
[诺德里]
他向托尔请求娶特鲁德，但不出所料，托尔拒绝了。阿尔维斯本该就此放弃，但他没有。

scripts.text:
[Nordri]
So Thor decided to test his knowledge by asking him some questions. The first question was, 'What is the name of the ground in human terms?' Do you know the answer?
scripts.translation:
[诺德里]
于是托尔决定通过提问来测试他的知识。第一个问题是：“用人类的语言来说，大地的名字是什么？”你知道答案吗？

scripts.text: Ymir's body
scripts.translation: 尤弥尔的身体

scripts.text: Earth
scripts.translation: 大地

scripts.text: Lane
scripts.translation: 道路

scripts.text: Universe
scripts.translation: 宇宙

scripts.text:
[Nordri]
Yes, that's right, 'Earth.' Alvis was able to also answer Thor's question correctly.
scripts.translation:
[诺德里]
没错，“大地”。
阿尔维斯也答对了这一问。

scripts.text:
[Nordri]
Thor then gave Alvis another question. What is the giant's term for the round shell that covers the earth?
scripts.translation:
[诺德里]
接着，托尔又问了他一个问题。在巨人的语言中，覆盖大地的圆形外壳叫什么？

scripts.text: Ymir's Head
scripts.translation: 尤弥尔的头

scripts.text: Sky
scripts.translation: 天空

scripts.text: Cloud Factory
scripts.translation: 云工厂

scripts.text: High House
scripts.translation: 高屋

scripts.text:
[Nordri]
That's it, 'High House.' Since the giants are so huge, it might have looked that way to them.
scripts.translation:
[诺德里]
没错，是“高屋”。因为巨人非常巨大，所以在他们看来可能就是这样。

scripts.text:
[Nordri]
So Thor gave him another question. What is the term for the ball that rises in the sky at night, as used by the gods?
scripts.translation:
[诺德里]
于是托尔又问了他一个问题。在众神的语言中，夜晚升上天空的球体叫什么？

scripts.text: Circling Wheel
scripts.translation: 旋转之轮

scripts.text: Moon
scripts.translation: 月亮

scripts.text: False Sun
scripts.translation: 假太阳

scripts.text: Fast Stranger
scripts.translation: 飞驰的过客

scripts.text:
[Nordri]
Yes! Gods refer to the
moon as the 'false sun.'
Although Alvis answered all of Thor's questions, he didn't notice the sun was rising.
scripts.translation:
[诺德里]
没错！众神称月亮为“假太阳”。
虽然阿尔维斯回答了托尔的所有问题，但他没有注意到太阳正在升起。

scripts.text:
[Nordri]
Yes...
Thor prolonged his test so that Alvis would be turned to stone
once the sun rose.
scripts.translation:
[诺德里]
是啊...托尔故意把问答拖得很长，就是要等到日出，让阿尔维斯化作石头。

scripts.text:
[Nordri]
There are two
things we can learn
from this story. First, do not covet something to the point of challenging fate or the gods.
scripts.translation:
[诺德里]
从中能明白两个道理。
第一，不要为了贪求某样东西，连命运和神都敢挑战。

scripts.text:
[Nordri]
Secondly, do not have too much pride in yourself. No matter how much ability or talent you may have, you cannot get everything
you want.
scripts.translation:
[诺德里]
第二，不要过于自负。无论你的能力或天赋有多高，你都无法得到你想要的一切。

scripts.text:
[Nordri]
It's most
important to live a
good and virtuous life. It's great to achieve your desires, but be aware that some desires are not meant to be fulfilled.
scripts.translation:
[诺德里]
做人，最要紧的是善良正直。
能实现心愿当然很好，可有些愿望，注定不能成真。

scripts.text:
[Nordri]
Thank you for listening to my long story. If you meet anyone afflicted with an insatiable desire, please tell him this story of Thor and Alvis, a brave yet very defiant Dwarf.
scripts.translation:
[诺德里]
谢谢你耐心听完。
若遇到有人欲壑难填，就把托尔和阿尔维斯的故事讲给他听吧。
那个矮人虽勇敢，却也太过桀骜。

scripts.text:
[Nordri]
Huh...?
I don't think that's right. Let me think, maybe I can remember it. Hopefully, it'll come to me sooner or later...
scripts.translation:
[诺德里]
嗯...？
好像不对。
让我想想，兴许慢慢就能记起来...

scripts.text:
[Nordri]
Shall we talk more of this once again after enjoying another Red Potion? Hahahahaha~
scripts.translation:
[诺德里]
要不，等我再喝瓶红色药水，咱们接着聊？
哈哈哈哈哈~

scripts.text:
[Nordri]
Oooh...
I'm sooo thirsty!
scripts.translation:
[诺德里]
哦哦...
我渴死了！

scripts.text:
[Nordri]
Hm, didn't I ask you to bring a Red Potion? There's no way I can tell any stories with such a dry throat~
scripts.translation:
[诺德里]
嗯，我不是让你带红色药水来吗？嗓子这么干，我没法讲故事啊~

scripts.text:
[Nordri]
What business
do you have with
me, human?
scripts.translation:
[诺德里]
你找我有什么事，人类？

scripts.text: Nothing.
scripts.translation: 没什么

scripts.text: Excuse me.
scripts.translation: 打扰一下

scripts.text:
[Nordri]
You're funny, leave me alone.
scripts.translation:
[诺德里]
你真有趣，别烦我了。

scripts.text:
[Nordri]
Odd. Recently, too many humans have been interested in meeting with me and my brothers. Still, I cannot say their visits have been unpleasant.
scripts.translation:
[诺德里]
奇怪。最近有太多人类想见我和我的兄弟们了。不过，我也不能说他们的来访不愉快。

scripts.text:
[Nordri]
I'm a little thirsty. Would you bring me a Red Potion. If you do that for me, I will tell you an important story. Heh heh heh~
scripts.translation:
[诺德里]
有点渴，能带瓶红色药水来吗？
作为回报，我给你讲个重要的故事。
嘿嘿嘿~

scripts.text:
[Nordri]
Zzzz Zzzz Zzzz...

[Nordri]
I am Nordri,
Dwarven Blacksmith.
scripts.translation:
[诺德里]
我是诺德里，矮人铁匠。

scripts.text:
[Nordri]
I am in charge of this Northern part of Mount Mjolnir. If you wish to pass, you must first secure my approval!
scripts.translation:
[诺德里]
我负责妙勒尼山脉北部的守卫工作。如果你想通过，必须先得到我的批准！

scripts.text:
[Nordri]
Ho ho ho...
Calm down, it
was only a joke.
Hahahahaha!
scripts.translation:
[诺德里]
呵呵呵...
别紧张，开个玩笑而已。
哈哈哈哈哈！

scripts.text:
[Nordri]
Zzzz Zzzz Zzzz...
